correctness.rationale: The helper implements the full exit/result contract inspectable in the diff: env defaults (INTERVAL/QUIET_WINDOW/MAX_WAIT), allow-list loading, pre/post head SHA checks, GraphQL snapshot parsing, terminal-bot semantics (review on current head with no unresolved threads from that bot), and RESULT=/HEAD= emission for CONVERGED, QUIET_ELAPSED, SHA_CHANGED, TIMEOUT, and API_ERROR with documented exit codes. Bats fixtures exercise each result path. Minor deduction: when no allow-listed bots have participated yet, participating_count and terminal_count are both zero with unresolved_count zero, so the script exits CONVERGED immediately rather than continuing to poll for expected bot activity—arguably premature for a settle-window helper.

quality.rationale: Implementation is clear, repo-consistent shell (set -euo pipefail, SCRIPT_DIR-relative allow-list path, shared check/bats wiring pattern). Documentation is synced across AI_REPO_GUIDE.md, scripts/README.md, scripts/tests/README.md, and the pr-resolve-all prompt with preserved time-based fallback. The Bats suite uses a reusable fake gh/date/sleep toolchain matching established fixture-driven patterns. Small deduction for an unused REPO_ROOT variable and a long but readable monolithic main loop.

process.rationale: Diff is tightly scoped to eight task-related files with no forbidden surfaces or scope drift. Required deliverables are all present: helper, allow-list, prompt preference with documented fallback, companion docs, dedicated check script (159-pr-resolve-all-poll.sh), and Bats registration. Objective process scored 15/15, consistent with focused, doc-synced work.

reliability.rationale: Verification wiring is strong: scripts/checks/159-pr-resolve-all-poll.sh invokes scripts/tests/pr-resolve-all-poll.bats; objective test_wiring passed 6/6 and bash -n/lint passed. Seven Bats cases cover CONVERGED, QUIET_ELAPSED, TIMEOUT, SHA_CHANGED, API_ERROR (auth and missing allow-list), and login normalization with deterministic fake tooling—credible contract-path coverage in code. Deduction because objective bats_poll_helper was skipped (not executed in bundle grading) and pagination/graphql-failure API_ERROR branches are implemented but not covered by tests.

citations.claim: hard_gate_pass is true, enabling normal subjective scoring rather than fail-closed zeroing.
print_result emits RESULT=<value> with optional HEAD=<sha> plus BOTS, TERMINAL_BOTS, UNRESOLVED_THREADS, LATEST_EVENT, and ELAPSED fields.
Exit paths map to contract: exit 0 CONVERGED/QUIET_ELAPSED, exit 2 TIMEOUT, exit 3 SHA_CHANGED, exit 4 API_ERROR via api_error().
Reviews are filtered to current head via select((.commit.oid // "") == $head); terminal bots require review_seen and no thread_seen for that bot.
Pre- and post-snapshot head SHA fetches bracket the GraphQL snapshot; mismatch triggers SHA_CHANGED exit 3.
snapshot_has_pagination fails closed with API_ERROR when review/thread pagination would undercount state.
CONVERGED branch fires when unresolved_count==0 and terminal_count==participating_count, including vacuously when participating_count is 0.
.github/prompts/pr-resolve-all.md adds settle-window helper preference and documents fallback to quiet-window timing on API_ERROR.
Eight changed files are limited to helper, allow-list, prompt, docs, check wiring, and Bats tests.
scripts/tests/pr-resolve-all-poll.bats includes seven tests covering CONVERGED, QUIET_ELAPSED, TIMEOUT, SHA_CHANGED, API_ERROR, and login normalization using fake gh/date/sleep fixtures.
bash_n_poll_helper and lint_poll_helper passed; test_wiring passed 6/6; bats_poll_helper skipped; correctness objective 18/20 with required_paths 16/16.
